## Fetching Dynamic Content

Projects data is available via the PocketBase REST API (PocketBase runs on its own subdomain):
GET https://pb.micio86dev.it/api/collections/projects/records

Each project record includes: title (per-locale: title_en / title_it / title_es), description (desc_en / desc_it / desc_es), tech tags, client, period, slug.
News/notes: GET https://pb.micio86dev.it/api/collections/news/records
